hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$json = Get-Content -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $file = $json.tool_input.file_path; if (Test-Path $file) { uv run ruff format $file; uv run ruff check --fix $file }; Write-Output (Get-Content -Raw)"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$jsonText = Get-Content -Raw; $json = $jsonText | ConvertFrom-Json; $file = $json.tool_input.file_path; if ($file -and (Test-Path $file)) { Write-Host '[Hook] Running mypy...' 1>&2; uv run mypy $file --no-error-summary 2>&1 | Select-String '(error|warning)' | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ 1>&2 } }; Write-Output $jsonText"
